key_strength: The flat gray roof has been replaced in presentation by low sloping roof masses with deep eaves, and the south entry now reads as a tall glazed pavilion. These address the largest R4 visual mismatch.
key_remaining_limits: Roof pitch, eave depth, ridge positions and transition heights are image-estimated; no registered roof/elevation drawing was found.
The raised central roof monitor is an interpretation and is not clearly supported by the single oblique Purdue exterior image.
The eye-level render still has repetitive small upper windows compared with the official photo's varied grouped openings.
Brick, glass and paving remain somewhat flat in Workbench inspection renders; the tree canopy also reads translucent in this studio setup.
No master scene was opened, so campus placement and neighboring alignment are not graded.
Interior remains a useful schematic, not a verified as-built layout.
scope: Independent standalone asset review and fresh-process reopen only; no asset/master/shared edits and no commit.
